fusions.name: Startle Burst
fusions.desc: A burst that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and throws each 3 tiles back, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Brought to Bay
fusions.desc: Bites a target at or below 30% health for 20 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It deals 5% more for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Clear the Fence
fusions.desc: Bounds 4 tiles forward, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: On the Scent
fusions.desc: Every few tiles you run, your next strike gains 15% critical hit chance. Once every 6 seconds.
